research_questions.question: How do residents confirm that a renewal succeeded?
What keeps residents from renewing online?

themes.claim: Residents looked for proof of payment before they considered the renewal done
themes.counter_evidence: Both participants discussed confirmation. Neither described a renewal they trusted without a receipt or bank record.

evidence.quote: I wasn't sure the payment went through, so I checked my bank app twice.
The receipt email came an hour later, which is when I finally relaxed.
evidence.display_quote: The receipt email came an hour later … when I finally relaxed.

evidence.quote: The clerk printed a receipt right away, so I knew it was done.

themes.claim: Distrust of the website kept one resident at the counter
themes.counter_evidence: P1 renewed online without hesitation. P2 was the only participant who chose the counter.

evidence.quote: I went to the counter because I didn't trust the website with my card.
evidence.display_quote: I went to the counter because I didn't trust [the city] website with my card.

evidence.quote: I renewed the permit on my phone during lunch.

recommendations.proposal: Show an immediate on-screen receipt and send the email at once.
